name: fixmycity
description: FixMyCity – civic issue reporting platform (citizen PWA, municipal command center, API)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci && npm --prefix admin ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client,admin -c green,blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix admin run build
